checks.description: pytest -q over tests/ at commit 07a7ff01fd2767f7ad34a6442c5a817536ac0a6d. 34 tests collected. The 6 skips are the parametrized evidence-manifest cases: at this commit no manifest existed yet, so their parameter set was empty. See limitations.

A fresh python3 -m venv .venv followed by pip install -e '.[dev]' resolved to the exact pinned versions, and requirements.lock was regenerated from that environment by make lock (pip freeze --exclude-editable). Python 3.13.5 on Debian GNU/Linux 13, x86-64.
.github/workflows/ci.yml is committed but was not executed by this package; no CI evidence exists. Recorded as not applicable rather than pass so that no CI claim is inferred from this manifest.

limitations: P00 maps to no D or A requirement in implementation plan section 5. Its acceptance evidence in plan section 4.1 is a clean baseline report, a reproducible environment, no overwritten user work, and initial requirement statuses; those are the checks above. The requirements array is therefore deliberately empty rather than padded with a requirement this package does not supply evidence for.

P00 is scaffolding. Nothing here is numerical verification, empirical validation, or optimality evidence. No equation, unit convention, state definition, zero-flow rule, residual, derivative, or solver behavior exists in this repository yet; the nine layer packages contain a docstring and nothing else.
No continuous-integration run was executed. .github/workflows/ci.yml is committed but has never run on GitHub Actions. Every result in this manifest was produced locally.

Single platform only: Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie), kernel 6.12.86+deb13-amd64, x86-64, CPython 3.13.5. The two-platform structural-identity evidence required by gate G05 is work package K05 and is not claimed here.

The six skipped pytest cases at this commit are the parametrized evidence-manifest checks (validation, placeholder rejection, path/content agreement, hash form, commit existence, review self-certification). They had an empty parameter set because this manifest did not exist yet. They are exercised from the following commit, which adds this file; that run's result is not recorded in this manifest, since a manifest cannot describe a commit later than the one it certifies.
The lint, format, type and test checks establish that the scaffolding is internally consistent. They establish nothing about the correctness of any future scientific code.

Requirement D17's owning packages are recorded in docs/requirements.yaml as the release-closing packages K06, T08, M07, S03, R01, R02, R03. Plan section 5 gives them as 'All release gates', which is not a package list; this expansion is an Opus bookkeeping interpretation awaiting Fable's confirmation and is noted in docs/progress.md under handoff.

No LICENSE text file exists. pyproject.toml declares license = 'Apache-2.0' as the intent recorded in blueprint section 15, but that section conditions adoption on the project holding distribution rights, so the text file awaits Frank's confirmation. The declared metadata and the absent file are deliberately inconsistent and visible.
